target.role: Senior Director, Asset and Liability Management (ALM)

summary: Candidate for Senior Director, Asset and Liability Management (ALM) with ~7 years across institutional ALM analytics, IRRBB modelling, and balance-sheet risk. Holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs across multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; ~$50bn cumulative) at Moody's Analytics, including parallel and non-parallel rate-shock analytics consistent with OSFI B-12 and Basel IRRBB frameworks. Designed an enterprise multi-scenario cash-flow and liquidity-gap engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios. Prior practitioner depth in stochastic ALM, LDI, and hedging analytics at Ortec Finance. CFA + dual MSc.
core_skills: Interest Rate Risk — IRRBB / OSFI B-12 aligned

sections.heading: Interest Rate Risk & Balance Sheet Analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement (~$50bn cumulative) — independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, consistent with OSFI B-12 Interest Rate Risk Management Guideline and Basel IRRBB frameworks, including EVE and NII sensitivity at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.
Validate rates, FX, and inflation derivatives outputs and cross-check sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates feeding balance-sheet risk assessment.

sections.heading: ALM Model Development, Stress Testing & Liquidity
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine — a core ALM model supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity-gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimisation, refinancing-risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioural cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations and executive contingency planning.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework — review ALM model assumptions, escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility, and serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and senior stakeholders.
Prepare ALM analytical summaries, dashboards, and committee-ready presentations on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines; deployed agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) reducing development cycle time approximately 30–40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform — advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Translated investment-team requirements into structured product/development requests; successfully migrated all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation and balance-sheet reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and program-management functions on governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes; coordinated milestone delivery across cross-functional teams.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors — analysed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk; advised clients on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimisation on VaR and CVaR via Ortec's GLASS platform; presented findings at client investment-committee meetings on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
